stem.text: A car travels along a straight horizontal road. The graph shows the variation of the velocity $v$ of the car with time $t$ for $6.0\,\text{s}$ of its journey.

stem.alt: Velocity-time graph with vertical axis v/m s-1 from 0 to 30 and horizontal axis t/s from 0 to 6.0, on a grid, with one plotted line.

stem.text: The brakes of the car are applied from $t = 1.0\,\text{s}$ to $t = 4.0\,\text{s}$.
How far does the car travel while the brakes are applied?
